gotchas: Guest checkout: no login needed. Flow is homepage search -> Price -> Passengers -> Seats -> Payment.

Search from the homepage form (#originationAirportCode, #destinationAirportCode, input[name="departureDate"], submit #flightBookingSubmit). A deep link to /air/booking/select-depart.html renders an empty flight list with no error.
Trip type defaults to Round-trip in a fresh browser; set One-way first or the search fails with 'Enter return date'.
The date picker stays open over the search button and intercepts the click; press Enter on #flightBookingSubmit instead.
Card fields are inline on southwest.com, not in a payment iframe. Card Type (#creditCardType) is a custom combobox and must be set (e.g. Visa) before the number.
Expiry is MMYY digits only. The CVV input has no recognisable id; it was located only as input[maxlength="4"] and has not been filled - verify before relying on it.
#creditCardStreetAddress has a short maxlength and truncated a full street line (fill_rejected).
Passenger step requires DOB (#passengerDateOfBirth-0, MMDDYYYY digits) and Gender (custom combobox); contact method combobox defaults to Text, switch to 'Email me' to get an email field.
Seat step: 'Skip all seats' link advances to payment; the 'Continue to payment' control is not a button.

CVV confirmed 2026-10-02 from a pre-fill snapshot: the field labelled 'CVV' is input#creditCardNewVerificationValue (maxlength 4), the only input[maxlength="4"] on the payment page. Its accessible name carries a trailing icon glyph, so match it as textbox "CVV..." rather than an exact name.
Fill the card number and the CVV back to back (expiry and the billing fields first), so nothing sits between the two card legs.
input[id*="mail"] matches TWO visible inputs on the payment page (the receipt email and its confirmation); fill both, by nth=0 and nth=1.

Billing #creditCardStreetAddress is maxlength 40, Zip 5, Phone 10 digits (country code is a separate combobox defaulting to +1), City 32, name on card 30 each. Country (#creditCardCountry) and State (#creditCardState) are readonly comboboxes, not text inputs.
Order total for an order.total hint: .checkout-totals--content li:last-child .currency (the 'Trip total' row) resolved to the right USD amount when declared before any fill.
2026-10-07: card number and CVV verified with the test card under a verification-only key (both fills card_fields_verified).
Trip type is a combobox ('Trip type options'): click it, then role=option[name=/one/i].
Passengers: #passengerFirstName-0, #passengerLastName-0, #passengerDateOfBirth-0 (MMDDYYYY typed), #passengerGender-0 combobox, #contactMethod combobox -> 'Email me' reveals input[id*="mail"].

The order.total hint on .checkout-totals--content li:last-child .currency resolved to 400 USD on 2026-10-07 (the page now carries a '$400 statement credit' card promo); the trip total was 168.40. Do not trust the hint here until fixed.

2026-10-07 optional sign-in: the 'Passenger Log in' button opens the form; the identifier is an account number or username, not an email (an email token is fill_rejected on maxlength). Fields role=textbox[name="Account number or username"] / role=textbox[name="Password"], submit role=button[name="Log in"]. Guest checkout needs none of it.
